Purpose:  lwIP OS-mode (NO_SYS=0) glue for FreeRTOS — semaphores, mutexes,
          mailboxes, tcpip thread creation — required by bm_core's
          network/bm_lwip.c backend. Config knobs it expects (e.g.
          LWIP_FREERTOS_CHECK_CORE_LOCKING) are set in ../../src/lwipopts.h.
